title: Fourteen observation bits for a fixed Boolean release protocol
description: For one frozen 56-rule Boolean model of the epithelial-mesenchymal transition and a fixed two-stage intervention, 14 additional observation bits are necessary and sufficient for the specified release guard to meet the safety, eventual-release and post-release requirements; the optimal 14-bit set is unique (checked by one ROBDD route). Includes the witnesses, saved UNSAT certificates, a certificate consumer and a separate ROBDD checker. Only this frozen model, intervention, guard and candidate set; no biological validity claim; no human peer review. Text/data CC BY 4.0; code Apache 2.0.
